queries_run: SharkNinja competitor threat Dyson Roborock Ecovacs Ninja competition 2026

findings.claim: 10-K稱公司已在各地區取得市佔，從價位高於與低於自家的對手手中拿走份額；Shark為美國floorcare第一品牌，Ninja為美國最暢銷小型廚房家電（Circana，截至2026-01-03）。為公司自述。
findings.excerpt: We have successfully gained market share across geographies, taking share from competitors priced both above and below our offerings.

findings.claim: 10-K列出主要對手：Shark對Dyson、Hoover、Bissell；Ninja對Vitamix、De'Longhi、Breville、Hamilton Beach、Cuisinart；Dyson亦在Beauty類別；無單一對手橫跨所有類別。
findings.excerpt: Shark competes with brands including Dyson, Hoover and Bissell.

findings.claim: 10-K風險因子：部分對手可能降價並接受較低利潤，公司可能流失市佔。
findings.excerpt: Some competitors may be willing to reduce prices and accept lower profit margins to compete with us. As a result of this competition, we could lose market share and sales or be forced to reduce our prices to meet competition.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋僅見公司自述與其引用的Circana；未找到獨立2026份額數據，亦無具名新進入者搶單的可引原文。Roborock/Dreame等僅見低品質來源，未列入。

clues.claim: Q1 2026 新聞稿：淨銷售+15.6%、各品類市場疲弱下仍取得份額（公司自述）
